release.note: n8n 3.0 changes take effect when you upgrade, not on a calendar date: self-hosted instances keep running 2.x until upgraded. The docs page says 3.0 is "scheduled for October 2026" (no exact day; checked 2026-10-01, when the latest stable release was n8n@2.41.5). That date is informational only; n8n findings are labeled "on upgrade to n8n 3.0" and only count toward the exit code with --target 3.0.

changes.title: AI Agent node version 1 removed
changes.message: AI Agent node version 1.x is removed in n8n 3.0, along with its agent modes (SQL, Conversational, OpenAI Functions, Plan and Execute, ReAct).
changes.replacement: Update the node to the latest AI Agent version (Tools Agent behaves the same). For SQL Agent, use a Postgres or MySQL tool sub-node with a recent AI Agent.
changes.note: The docs say "version 1"; n8n source maps typeVersions 1 to 1.9 to the V1 implementation, so all 1.x versions are flagged.

changes.title: Execute Sub-workflow: "Run once for each item" mode removed
changes.message: The "Run once for each item" mode of the Execute Sub-workflow node is no longer available in n8n 3.0, so the node fails.
changes.replacement: Add a Loop Over Items node before a new Execute Sub-workflow node set to "Run once with all items".
changes.note: Not listed on the n8n 3.0 breaking changes page (checked 2026-10-02). n8n's own Migration Report has a v3 rule for it (execute-workflow-each-mode-v3), n8n@2.41.5 marks the mode deprecated, and on the 3.x branch the node says the mode "is no longer available, so this node will fail".

changes.title: Execute Sub-workflow: Local File and URL sources removed
changes.message: The "Local File" and "URL" sources of the Execute Sub-workflow node are removed in n8n 3.0; nodes using them fail with an error.
changes.replacement: Import the sub-workflow and select it with the "Database" source, or paste its JSON with "Define Below" ("Parameter" on node versions 1.1 and older).

changes.title: $getPairedItem helper removed
changes.message: The $getPairedItem expression helper is removed in n8n 3.0.
changes.replacement: Use item linking instead: the pairedItem property or $("<node-name>").item.

changes.title: $evaluateExpression() removed from the Code node
changes.message: $evaluateExpression() is removed from the Code node (JavaScript) in n8n 3.0. Secure-mode task runners, the default since n8n 2.0, already fail on this call.
changes.replacement: Evaluate the expression in a node field (for example an Edit Fields (Set) node before the Code node) and read the result from the input item.

changes.title: Gmail Trigger versions 1 to 1.3 run as version 1.4
changes.message: Gmail Trigger versions below 1.4 run with version 1.4 behavior in n8n 3.0: Max Emails per Poll applies (default 10), drafts are skipped unless "Include Drafts" is on, and sent or scheduled emails outside the inbox no longer trigger.
changes.replacement: Turn on "Include Drafts" if the workflow relies on drafts; for sent or scheduled emails, use a Schedule Trigger followed by the Gmail node's "Get Many" messages operation.

changes.title: Always Output Data on nodes with several outputs
changes.unverifiedNote: The docs page names If and Switch as examples of "nodes with several outputs". Compare Datasets (4 outputs) and Loop Over Items v3 (2 outputs) have several outputs in n8n source but are not named on the page.
changes.message: With "Always Output Data" on, n8n 3.0 adds an empty item only when every output is empty; before, each empty output got one, so other branches ran.
changes.replacement: Review the node and adjust "Always Output Data" to match your intent.

changes.title: Webflow OAuth2 credential: Legacy toggle off by default
changes.message: The Webflow OAuth2 credential's "Legacy" toggle defaults to off in n8n 3.0. Credentials that never saved it request v2 scopes on reconnect, which a legacy Webflow v1 app rejects.
changes.replacement: Turn on "Legacy" on the Webflow OAuth2 credential before reconnecting it, or move the node to version 2.

changes.title: Chat Trigger: WebSocket messages are JSON frames
changes.message: In "Using Response Nodes" mode, the chat WebSocket now sends every frame as JSON with a "type" field; custom clients expecting raw strings break.
changes.replacement: Parse every frame as JSON and switch on "type", or update an embedded @n8n/chat widget to 1.31.0 or later.

changes.title: Lower Compression node decompression limits
changes.message: Default decompression limits drop to 256 MiB (from 2 GiB) and 1,000 ZIP entries (from 5,000) in n8n 3.0; larger archives fail.
changes.replacement: Set N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_DECOMPRESSED_SIZE_BYTES=2147483648 and N8N_COMPRESSION_NODE_MAX_ZIP_ENTRIES=5000 if you decompress larger archives.

openai.matching: Model IDs and listed aliases match exactly. Entries from the "Model family / snapshot" table (matchDatedSnapshots) also match dated snapshots such as <id>-2025-08-28. Fine-tuned IDs (ft:<base>:...) are matched to the page's ft-<base> labels by base-model prefix and reported as unverified. Legacy fine-tune IDs (<base>:ft-...) match legacyFineTunes. Provider-prefixed IDs (openai/<model>, as used by OpenRouter) match the model after the prefix and are reported as unverified warnings, because the provider runs its own schedule.
openai.endpointMatching: Endpoints match by URL path (and every path below it, unless exactPath is set): in HTTP Request nodes, only in the url field, when it is on api.openai.com or the node uses OpenAI credentials with an expression URL; in Code nodes that mention api.openai.com, only inside api.openai.com URLs or string literals that start with the path. Header entries match an OpenAI-Beta header with that value. Entries with a method only apply to that HTTP method. objectIdPrefix entries match a quoted object ID with that prefix (for example "pmpt_...") in request bodies and code. nodeUsages list n8n nodes that call the endpoint themselves: a node of that type, within minTypeVersion and maxTypeVersion when set (a missing typeVersion counts as 1), with the parameter set to the value when one is given (parameterDefault when the export omits it), and the requires path non-empty when set. The operation is read from operationParameter (default "operation"), falling back to defaultOperation because n8n omits defaults from exports; operations not listed do not match.
openai.excluded: Left out because they are not endpoints a workflow calls: Agent Builder (a dashboard product), the 2024 restriction on new fine-tuning training for babbage-002 and davinci-002, and the 2026-05-07 and 2026-07-02 fine-tuning restrictions that only apply to some organizations (noted on the fine-tuning job creation entry).

nodeUsages.label: OpenAI node, "Assistant" resource
nodeUsages.replacement: OpenAI node version 2: the Text resource's "Message a Model" operation (Responses API) or the Conversation resource (Conversations API)
nodeUsages.note: Type versions 1 to 1.8 run the node's V1 implementation, whose "Assistant" resource calls /assistants directly and /threads through the OpenAI SDK ("Message an Assistant", the default operation). Version 2 has no Assistant resource; its Text "Message a Model" operation calls /responses and its Conversation resource calls /conversations. n8n's 3.x branch still ships versions 1 to 1.8.

nodeUsages.label: OpenAI Assistant node
nodeUsages.replacement: OpenAI node version 2: the Text resource's "Message a Model" operation (Responses API) or the Conversation resource (Conversations API)
nodeUsages.note: Both operations (the "mode" parameter, labelled Operation) call /assistants: "Use Existing Assistant" updates the assistant's tools with client.beta.assistants.update, and "Use New Assistant" creates one with OpenAIAssistantRunnable.createAssistant. The assistant then runs through LangChain's OpenAIAssistantRunnable, which calls client.beta.threads.createAndRun and threads.runs. All type versions (1, 1.1) do this. n8n 3.0 also removes the node.

anthropic.matching: Model IDs and the one documented alias (claude-sonnet-4-5) match exactly. Only models with an announced retirement date are listed: the "Deprecation history" tables of the deprecations page, which also give the recommended replacement. The status table is not used, because its "Not sooner than ..." dates for active models are earliest-possible floors, not announcements.
anthropic.excluded: Left out: claude-mythos-preview (deprecated 2026-06-09, retirement "To be announced"); active models with only a "Not sooner than" date (including claude-haiku-4-5-20251001); the -latest and -0 aliases of retired models (claude-3-5-haiku-latest, claude-3-7-sonnet-latest, claude-sonnet-4-0, claude-opus-4-0, claude-opus-4-1 and similar), because no official page lists them by name; Amazon Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI model IDs, which follow their own retirement schedules; deprecated API parameters (temperature, top_p, top_k).

gemini.matching: Model IDs match exactly, with or without the "models/" prefix and a trailing ":generateContent"-style method. gemini.excluded: Left out: rows that say "No shutdown date announced" (including gemini-3-flash-preview, which has a replacement but no date); the managed agent antigravity-preview-05-2026 (an agent, not a model ID); the Gemini 1.5 models and others the release notes only report as "now shut down" without an earlier dated announcement; gemini-omni-flash-preview, which the release notes say will be deprecated (not shut down) on 2026-09-30; Vertex AI model IDs, which have their own lifecycle.
